
Expertise in project coordination activities and ensuring completion of the projects within the time & budget and optimizing resource utilization. Expert level in various networking technologies such as TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP, and High-level knowledge of cisco Meraki wireless, and Cisco Identity Service Engine. Special proficiency in Configuration, Implementation, and Maintenance of Cisco Network and PAN Security Devices. Professional level understanding of IPsec VPNs and real-world implementation and troubleshooting experience. Serves as technical advisor for Managed Services customers taking a lead role in providing technical solutions and fixes. Perform preventive maintenance services - Update network diagram, cabling documentation, rack diagram, labels, inventory verification, etc.
Hands-on experience analyzing high volumes of firewall logs, network data (e.g., Packet Capture on Wireshark).  Professional level understanding of TCP and UDP including the ability to identify the root cause of exclusive problems through packet capture analysis. Experience with developing and auditing firewall rules in an enterprise network environment and project management.
Configured, troubleshoot, and upgraded Palo Alto Firewalls for Manage clients, which included network and
resource access, software, or hardware problems. Experience in configuration and troubleshooting of VPN Technologies (Site to Site, Client to site) and High availability/ Context functions in Palo Alto firewalls.

CCNP (Cisco Certified Network Professional)  PCNSA (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator)  CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)  Palo Alto Networks Automation with API & Python  Python (Basics)

Experience:
NIKE India Technology Center (OCT 2025 to Present) – SWE II Core Infrastructure
Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure across retail, campus, and warehouse sites, including core routing/switching, wireless, and firewall configurations for new store turn-ups and site expansions.

``

Lead infrastructure delivery for new retail locations, including wireless survey/mapping, network design, hardware deployment, and full live cutover support. Led end-to-end Panorama migration from on-prem to AWS, including cloud provisioning, production panorama configuration replication, and cutover of global firewalls to the new VM Panorama instance..  Developed Splunk dashboards with real-time charts to monitor Cisco ISE authentication, firewall traffic/blocks, and wireless certificate status, and built self-service troubleshooting views to speed up incident resolution.  Defined and implemented a new office-site connectivity standard using Palo Alto firewalls to regional hubs,

improving cost efficiency and simplifying network operations.
Developed and maintained automation workflows using GitHub for source control, Cursor for accelerated development, and Jenkins for continuous integration and deployment.
Create and maintain accurate project documentation, hardware inventory, and network diagrams to support

design, implementation, and day-to-day operations. Provide L2/L3 operational support across the APLA region, troubleshooting complex routing, switching, and firewall incidents to minimize business impact and restore service quickly.
Skyworks Semiconductor Pvt Ltd India (June 2023 to OCT 2025) – Senior Network Administrator 1

Implemented and maintaining Cisco SDWAN Architecture across all the Skyworks solutions Office and factory sites. Implemented and maintaining the Software Defined LAN (SDA-DNAC) and wireless controller Solution. Performed creating VIP pools and nodes and creating custom iRules for virtual servers, like cookie persistency and URL redirection on F5. Firewall policy reviewed and optimized the policies and removed non-compliant policies across all the Skyworks solutions Firewalls.
Deployed the new devices and troubleshooting the wireless issues in Cisco Meraki wireless access points.  Configuring failover for redundancy purposes for Network Security devices (Palo Alto Firewall).  Worked on the migration to exchange the Cisco SDWAN, Palo Alto Firewalls, and Cisco Switches.
